outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 40 patients diagnosed with placental abruption and 41 healthy controls who underwent cesarean section delivery at >= 34 weeks of gestation
finding: MSAFP levels were significantly higher in the group with placental abruption compared to healthy controls, and a negative correlation was found between MSAFP levels and Apgar scores in the placental abruption group.
birth_weight: Lower in the placental abruption group
